lead_raw_text:
The structure of Co8Ni2O16 (Co4NiO8) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers in octahedral environments with six O neighbors, while Ni centers have four O neighbors and O centers coordinate to one Co and one Ni. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Co octahedra and edge-sharing between Ni and Co polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites.
